# affogato-contracts (generated, do not edit)

Python types (official `protobuf` runtime plus `.pyi` stubs) for the Affogato contracts in
`proto/affogato/*/v1`.

`src/affogato/` is generated by `buf generate` (plugins `protocolbuffers/python` and
`protocolbuffers/pyi`, pinned in `buf.gen.yaml`). Do not edit it by hand: change the `.proto`
files and regenerate with

```sh
make contracts-gen
```

`pyproject.toml` is the only hand-maintained file; keep the `protobuf` requirement at the
pinned plugin version (the generated modules check the runtime version on import).

```sh
pip install ./gen/python
python -c "from affogato.events.v1 import chunk_events_pb2"
```
